## R: Distribución Normal

<div class="block-note mb-12">
<div class="block-body text-justify" style="font-size: 26px;">
El peso de gulupa en gramos sigue una $N(\mu=85,\, \sigma=12)$. Calcule $P(X \leq 80)$, $P(X > 100)$, $P(X \geq 90)$ y $P(70 \leq X \leq 95)$.
</div>
</div>

<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 20px; align-items: start;">

<div class="scrollable-code" style="min-width: 0;">

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| comment: ""
#| class-source: scrollable-code
mu <- 85; sigma <- 12

# Menor o igual que 80
pnorm(80, mu, sigma)

# Estrictamente menor que 80 (igual para continua)
pnorm(80, mu, sigma)

# Mayor que 100
pnorm(100, mu, sigma, lower.tail = FALSE)

# Mayor o igual que 90 (igual para continua)
pnorm(90, mu, sigma, lower.tail = FALSE)

# Entre 70 y 95 (inclusive)
pnorm(95, mu, sigma) - pnorm(70, mu, sigma)
```
</div>

<div class="card card--info" style="font-size: 23px; line-height: 1.9;">
<strong><code>dnorm(x, mean, sd): </code></strong>
<span class="text-slate" style="font-size: 24px;">$f(x)$</span><br><br>

<strong><code>pnorm(q, mean, sd):</code></strong>
<span class="text-slate" style="font-size: 24px;">$P(X \leq q)$</span><br><br>

<strong><code>lower.tail = FALSE: </code></strong>
<span class="text-slate" style="font-size: 24px;">$P(X > q)$</span><br><br>

<strong><code>pnorm(b) - pnorm(a): </code></strong>
<span class="text-slate" style="font-size: 24px;">$P(a \leq X \leq b)$</span><br><br>

<div class="block-alert mt-8">
<div class="block-title">Nota: variable continua</div>
<div class="block-body" style="font-size: 21px;">
$P(X = x) = 0$ siempre.<br>
$P(X \leq q) = P(X < q)$
</div>
</div>
</div>

</div>
